policy.before_trial: Look up canonical tool and prior findings before installing, downloading or testing; absence from router profiles is not absence of a prior review.
policy.retest: Do not repeat unchanged failed, rights-blocked or completed tests. Record a changed revision, permission/terms, requirement or unresolved specific capability that justifies a bounded follow-up.
policy.separate: Documentation review, runtime attempt, technical pass, owner preference, rights and public publication are distinct. Unknown is not failure.
policy.authority: A queued item is not install, model download, purchase, account, upload or autonomous execution authority.
